title: 1637 Prairie's bow and chimneys, closer to the engraving
items: The rounded bay at the north end of 1637 Prairie Avenue now stops just under the main cornice with a cap of its own, and the cornice runs straight across above it, as the old engraving of Jesse Spalding's remodel draws it. Before, the cornice swept round the top of the bay.

Each of the house's three chimneys now has clay pots on top, standing where the engraving draws a dark crown over each one. The engraving is too small to show whether they were plain pots or hooded cowls, so the pots are a reconstruction. Liberty L-k01-1637-stack-pots-2782 records it.
